I'll pull up your bench history first. Nothing is logged for bench in the app yet, and I don't see a program set up, so I can't tell you where it stalled. I can give you the general playbook, though.

Most bench stalls come down to a few things: too little weekly volume on the lift, grinding every set to failure, sleep or food falling short, or the same rep range for months. The usual fixes are to add a second bench day with lighter volume, work in a different rep range for a few weeks (heavy triples, then back to sets of 6 to 8), and stop sets with one or two reps in the tank so you can actually recover. A close-grip or dumbbell variation and some triceps work help too. Check that your setup is tight: feet planted, shoulder blades pinned back, and the bar path a slight arc over the lower chest.

If you tell me what you're lifting now and how long it's been stuck, I can get more specific. Want me to build you a program with bench pinned as a priority?
